newsitem.title: DUBAI: Jordan's King Hussein to meet King Fahd in Saudi.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein to meet King Fahd in Saudi.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan on Thursday made a pilgrimage to the Moslem holy city of Mecca in Saudi Arabia and was due to meet King Fahd in the capital Riyadh later in the day, sources close to the Jordanian monarch said.

Jordan's ties with its large oil-rich neighbour were strained in 1990 when King Hussein refused to join Saudi Arabia and other Arab and Western countries in a military coalition to drive Iraqi occupation troops from Kuwait.
The two leaders put aside six years of bitterness last year when King Fahd, who snubbed the Jordanian monarch during his February pilgrimage, met him for talks in August on Middle East peace efforts.
King Hussein is scheduled to return to Jordan late on Thursday, the sources said.
The Jordanian king, whose great-grandfather was ruler of Mecca until its capture by King Fahd's father King Abdul-Aziz in 1924, performed the minor pilgrimage of Umra.
